remarks: The OS/death-risk comparison was aligned, but the 33% between-arm relative reduction in mortality risk was incorrectly stored as the arm-specific rate_I value.
The same DFS endpoint was split again as a separate CU for the 3-year absolute difference, although the core DFS result was already represented in G001.
The multivariable DFS result for node-positive patients was an additional analytic-model result and did not warrant a separate CU.
The node-negative subgroup reported only a nonsignificant effect and interaction-test context without an independently attributable effect estimate, so no separate CU was supported.
The prediction omitted the direct 8-year DFS comparison between the two sequential treatment strategies.
The prediction omitted the direct 8-year OS comparison between the two sequential treatment strategies.
The prediction omitted the direct 8-year DRFI comparison between the two sequential treatment strategies.
The prediction omitted the direct 8-year BCFI comparison between the two sequential treatment strategies.
The ITT HR and P value for CMF versus observation were aligned, but the 26% relative recurrence-risk reduction was incorrectly stored in rate_I and the comparator was labeled as Reference.

The RFS endpoint and HR were aligned, but the total 437 trial events were entered in both arm-specific rate fields and the two 5-year RFS rates were omitted; P002 was an unnecessary split of the same CU.
The OS endpoint and HR were aligned, but the total 266 deaths were entered in both arm-specific rate fields and the two 5-year OS rates were omitted; P004 was an unnecessary split of the same CU.
The 5-year RFS rates belonged in the CU corresponding to P001 and should not have been represented as a separate CU.
The 5-year OS rates belonged in the CU corresponding to P003 and should not have been represented as a separate CU.
DFS, HR, and P value were aligned, but the 3.4% absolute risk reduction was incorrectly stored in rate_I and the CU was incorrectly downgraded to a nonprimary analysis.
OS, HR, and P value were aligned, but the 2.2% absolute risk reduction was incorrectly represented as an arm-specific rate.
The anastrozole-versus-tamoxifen DFS result was only directional and lacked an independently attributable effect estimate, so the additional CU was unsupported.
The 5-year RFI rate was correct, but the prediction represented the pooled treatment population as a single-arm CU, whereas the reference retained the chemotherapy-regimen comparison context.
The 5-year DRFI rate was correct, but the comparison structure and comparator representation did not match the source-supported reference CU.
The 5-year OS rate was correct, but the prediction represented the pooled population as a single-arm evaluation rather than preserving the comparison context.
The RFI event count was another representation of the same endpoint and should have been combined with the 5-year RFI result instead of forming a separate CU.
The DRFI event count was another representation of the same endpoint and should have been combined with the 5-year DRFI result instead of forming a separate CU.
The crossover-adjusted OS sensitivity analysis did not report an independent numerical result, so it did not support a separate CU.
Duration of response was a secondary extended outcome outside the reference CU scope and did not support a separate CU.
The PFS HR and P value were aligned, but the 18-month PFS rate was split into P002; the matched CU therefore lacked the rate and was incorrectly labeled as a boundary primary analysis.
The 18-month PFS rate belonged in P001 and should not have been represented as a separate CU.
The stepwise-selected model and P003 reported the same interaction effect; P004 was a duplicate analytic split that should have been merged or removed.
The prediction omitted the multivariable pCR comparison for triple-negative versus Luminal B-like disease with OR=4.85.
The age-adjusted OR and P value were aligned, but the simultaneous-treatment group was assigned to the intervention and the sequential group to the comparator, reversing the reference orientation.
The DFS P value was aligned, but the intervention and comparator were reversed and the analysis was incorrectly labeled as nonprimary.
The OS P value was aligned, but the intervention and comparator were reversed and the analysis was incorrectly labeled as nonprimary.
The immediate post-radiotherapy breast-symptom difference and P value were aligned, but the mean difference was incorrectly stored in the HR field instead of the result-value field.
The 3-month breast-symptom mean difference had the same field-attribution error and was stored under the wrong result type.
The baseline global-health score was not a post-treatment comparative outcome and did not support a separate CU.
Time to receipt of chemotherapy was an extended outcome outside the reference CU scope.
The pCR comparison, OR, and P value were aligned, but the intervention and comparator were reversed and the two arm-specific rates were consequently exchanged.
The tumor-feature-adjusted DRFS estimate was an additional analytic-model result and did not support a separate CU.
The tumor-feature-adjusted OS estimate was an additional analytic-model result and did not support a separate CU.
This result belonged in the CU corresponding to P002 and should not have been represented separately.
This result belonged in the CU corresponding to P003 and should not have been represented separately.
The adjusted PFS HR and P value were aligned, but the median PFS was split into P002 and should have been combined with P004.
The adjusted OS HR and P value were aligned, but the median OS was split into P003 and should have been combined with P005.
The median PFS value belonged in P004 and should not have been represented as a separate CU.
The median OS value belonged in P005 and should not have been represented as a separate CU.
The prediction omitted the DFS association for PD-1-positive immune cells in triple-negative breast cancer with HR=0.50.
The 5-year DFS rate belonged in P001 and should not have been represented as a separate CU.
The 7-year DFS rate belonged in P001 and should not have been represented as a separate CU.

The prediction merged the overall time results for three arms into one record and could not replace the three required pairwise CUs; it only partially corresponded to zoledronic acid versus clodronate.
The prediction did not construct a separate time-to-event comparison between zoledronic acid and ibandronate.
The prediction did not construct a separate time-to-event comparison between clodronate and ibandronate.
Time to treatment discontinuation was an additional outcome outside the reference CU scope.
The 2-year OS rate belonged in P002 and should not have been represented as a separate CU.
The 3-year OS rate belonged in P002 and should not have been represented as a separate CU.
The 36-month PFS rate belonged in P001 and should not have been represented as a separate CU.
